name: Mantle Portal
description: Query fund positions, look-through exposure to portfolio companies, and derive data and insights from documents like LPAs, capital calls, and K-1s directly within Claude. Mantle Portal integrates into your investment workflow, providing plain-language Q&A and analysis grounded in live data with reference back to source documents. Designed for family offices, endowments, pensions, and fund-of-funds GPs who manage positions across numerous funds and legal entities.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mantle Portal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mantle Portal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://portal.withmantle.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mantle Portal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mantle Portal provides these MCP tools: mantle_portal_get_soi_lookthrough, mantle_portal_list_document_types, mantle_portal_list_entities, mantle_portal_list_investments, mantle_portal_list_orgs, mantle_portal_list_securities, mantle_portal_list_soi_holdings, and mantle_portal_research_documents.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mantle Portal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mantle Portal in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Mantle Portal MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mantle Portal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mantle Portal is developed by Mantle. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
